headline: Flyers' Matvei Michkov has not requested a trade: Source
take: The Flyers' answer, as The Athletic and Daily Faceoff report it, is firm: GM Danny Briere says neither Matvei Michkov nor his agent asked for a trade and there is no plan to move him, after ESPN's Kevin Weekes reported Michkov would welcome a fresh start. On the ice Michkov is doing his job. He has 10 goals and 15 points in 21 games, with seven of those points on the power play, and he has scored 4.5 more goals than his chances would predict. The harder part is everything around him: at five on five the Flyers have just 42% of the expected goals with him on the ice. A 5-10-6 team that is losing the chance battle is a difficult place to be a young star, whatever the paperwork says.
